description: UNAVAILABLE — Suunto's API gateway currently rejects this endpoint (/v2/workout/samples) with 401 OperationNotFound on the account it was tested with (September 2026), so the call fails with an 'endpoint unavailable' error; it is not an authentication problem. Use get_workout_fit with full=true for record-level data (heart rate etc.), or get_workout_laps for laps. Kept so the tool starts working again if Suunto restores the endpoint. Read-only.

workoutKey.description: Opaque server-assigned string returned by list_workouts. Not guessable or constructable — always discover via list_workouts first. Passing an invalid key throws SuuntoNotFoundError.

name: get_workout_samples
